description.zh: 要删除的防护对象组名称。
description.en: The name of the protected object group that you want to delete.

description.zh:
WAF实例ID。

> 您可以通过调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)接口查看当前WAF实例ID。
description.en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region in which the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: The Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: Outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi delete-defense-resource-group --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --group-name group221 --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi DeleteDefenseResourceGroup --region cn-hangzhou --GroupName group221 --ResourceManagerResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm000q' --InstanceId waf_cdnsdf30000 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
